newsitem.title: UK: SIA 747 freighter to lift Irish-Asia trade.
newsitem.headline: SIA 747 freighter to lift Irish-Asia trade.

text.p: The first flight of Singapore Airlines Ltd Boeing 747-400 freighter service to Dublin on October 27 will bring in some 50 tonnes of cargo from the Far East, the airline's UK cargo manager Barry Gibson told Reuters.
The carrier's "Mega-Ark" freighter is due to touch down at 1925 local time after flying from Singapore via Dubai, he added in a telephone interview.
Dublin has been allocated 12 to 15 tonnes of cargo capacity and after a two hour stopover, it will leave on the return journey, routing via Copenhagen, Dubai and then Singapore.

The decision to introduce the service reflects Ireland's growing importance as a hi-tech export country, driven by strong inward foreign investment and one of the fastest growing economies in Europe, Gibson added.
At present Singapore Airlines is trucking a monthly average of 130 tonnes of cargo, largely hi-tech goodss, to Ireland from London's Heathrow airport.
The new freighter will provide a faster high quality delivery, he said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
